en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a wide seaside promenade with scattered pedestrians, some holding parasols. To the left is a long pier or jetty extending into the sea; in the background a densely built hillside town rises above the waterfront. On the right stands a large multi‑storey neoclassical building. The caption at the bottom is printed in Greek and French and identifies the scene as the promenade at the beach of Neo Faliro.
